blocks.text: Even though it is over a year away, the Executive Committee has discussed collecting a list of those interested in being a Delegate to the 2026 Libertarian National Convention, which will be held in Grand Rapids, Michigan. If you are interested, please contact us at info@ lpny.org. A formal application will be set up in the future.
